fact: Statistics Botswana published preliminary labour force results (unemployment 21.0% for ages 15+) from the nationally representative 2024/25 Botswana Multi Topic Household Survey (fieldwork Nov 2024 to Nov 2025), in a brief dated March 2026 (Version 2).
The brief refers to the 2022 Population and Housing Census as a de facto count of the entire population.

Statistics Botswana presented findings of the nationally representative 2024 Household Access and Individual Use of ICTs Survey (fieldwork June to August 2024), e.g. internet use 57.5%; no release date given, so the document's published date is used.
The annual report gives a 2022 actual count of 2,359,609 people and states the Population and Housing Census was conducted.
The profile lists a population census within the last 10 years as yes, dated 2011.
The profile lists MICS2 (2000) as an available national health survey.
The profile lists a DHS (1988) as an available national health survey.
Minister Segokgo, reported by BOPA, cites the 2022 census as the source of Botswana's population figure, so a census was counted in 2022.
